lines.text: Coming down the mountain, Jesus meets a crowd, and a man says a spirit keeps seizing his only son.
The disciples could not drive out the spirit, so Jesus rebuked it, healed the boy, and gave him back to the priest.
Jesus tells His disciples the Son of Man will be delivered into the hands of men, but they do not understand.
When the disciples argue about who is greatest, Jesus has a tax collector stand beside Him and says the least is greatest.
John says they tried to stop a man driving out demons in Jesus' name, but Jesus says not to stop him.
